chunks.title: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow
chunks.heading: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow
chunks.text:
Create or verify the material article in Catalog, including required colors and sizes.
Ensure the article is included in the relevant BOM with the required consumption, wastage, price and supplier details.
Generate MRP after the sales order is available; review the resulting indent in the User Indent List.
Open the indent and check the required quantity, material attributes and available stock.
If suitable stock is available, use the applicable in-house or equivalent-stock process. Otherwise, create an RMPO.
Complete all mandatory RMPO fields and verify quantity, price, supplier, dates, currency and UOM conversion.
Follow the RMPO status and track PO, GRN, receipt and dispatch quantities through the relevant screens.
Before you begin: Confirm that the article, supplier, user permissions and relevant configuration are available. Screen fields and options can vary by role and system setup.
The sourcing process in WFX starts in the Catalog, where the required material article is created. Once set up, the article can be used for inventory management and procurement.
The Catalog supports different material categories, such as Trims, Textiles/Fabric, general items and yarns.
• Step 1: The sourcing or merchandising team creates the required article in WFX Catalog.
• Step 2: Add the applicable colors and sizes to the article.
chunks.locator: § Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow

chunks.title: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow
chunks.heading: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow
chunks.text:
• While making bom (bill of material ) for Apparel /Style Merchant team add the same article in the bom and define color/size dependency along with consumption wastage price supplier who will be the purchase officer so that material can be procured for the required style as per the requirement .
• Step 4: After the sales order is created, the merchandising team runs Material Requirements Planning (MRP). The system generates the required indent(s).
• Step 5: The sourcing team reviews the generated indents. They can procure material from a supplier by creating an RMPO, or fulfill the requirement using available in-house or eligible equivalent stock.
The User Indent List displays the indents assigned or available to the logged-in user.
Indents displayed in this list may be user-specific and may not be visible to other users.
WFX also supports adhoc purchasing. The sourcing team can create an adhoc indent for reasons such as:
Material procurement against an order.
Sample order.
None (general sourcing).
To create an adhoc indent, select the indent type first. Then enter the material, quantity, price, supplier and other required details. The indent can then be used to create a purchase order.
If the indent type is OC, select the relevant OC number before creating the indent.
In the Article section, select the material category and then the article to be procured.
chunks.locator: § Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow (part 2)

chunks.title: Indent Overview
chunks.heading: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow › Indent Overview
chunks.text:
Select an indent number to open its overview. The overview may display the following information:
Indent number
Style details
Article details
OC number
Supplier and buyer name
Price assigned on bom
Bom line number
Color and size specification
Required quantity, ordered quantity, in-house quantity, on-order quantity and open quantity.
For roll allocation, the requested roll quantity.
From the indent overview, select Create New PO to create an RMPO. If suitable material is already available, use In-House Adjustment where permitted. A green indicator may identify a requirement for which stock is available.
Select Create New PO. WFX opens the RMPO screen, where you can enter the purchase-order details.
Complete the mandatory fields on the RMPO screen and enter or verify the material details before creating the order.
Creating a purchase order from the User Indent List
The User Indent List may allow multiple indents of the same category to be combined into one RMPO.
Fields highlighted in red are mandatory. Complete them before saving or submitting the RMPO.
Supplier portal
WFX supports a Supplier Portal. If the supplier is configured with a login and the Supplier Portal feature is enabled, the RMPO is sent to the supplier portal for approval.
chunks.locator: § Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow › Indent Overview

chunks.title: Indent Overview
chunks.heading: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow › Indent Overview
chunks.text:
The supplier may also create a Sourcing Advance Shipping Notice (ASN) against the RMPO. The inventory team can use the ASN as a reference when receiving the material in WFX.
When the Supplier Portal is enabled, a newly created RMPO may remain in an Unconfirmed status until the supplier responds.
To access the Supplier Portal, open the applicable server URL and sign in with the supplier's user ID and password. Check the supplier master for the configured login details.
Use the company ID and username configured for that supplier.
After the supplier approves the RMPO in the portal, its status is updated automatically in the WFX My Purchase Order list.
The supplier can also create a Sourcing ASN directly in WFX, where this option is enabled.
The inventory team can use the ASN details to create the corresponding receipt in WFX.
chunks.locator: § Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow › Indent Overview (part 2)

chunks.title: Supplier Block Booking
chunks.heading: Quick Start: Standard Sourcing Flow › Supplier Block Booking
chunks.text:
WFX also provides a Supplier Block Booking option.
Create a supplier block booking based on the supplier's confirmation for quantities expected to be received by month, season or year.
The booking can later be linked to RMPOs. This helps the team compare the booked quantity with the quantity actually ordered or received from the supplier.

chunks.title: Sourcing Module Overview
chunks.heading: Sourcing Module Overview
chunks.text:
The Sourcing Module is used to manage raw-material procurement and fulfillment activities. From a user perspective, the module supports supplier selection, purchase-order creation, indent monitoring, stock utilization, receipt tracking and sourcing reports.
Main working areas include:
• Supplier – view and use supplier master data across sourcing categories.
• My Purchase Order – create and manage Raw Material Purchase Orders (RMPOs).
• Indent Management / Indent List – review, activate, assign and work with indents.
• Indent Fulfillment Status – monitor open, ordered, received, adjusted and dispatched quantities.
• Reporting & Analysis – review indent and purchase-order reporting.
Under my purchase order we have multiple option like :
• Search of Raw material purchase order.
• List of raw material Purchase order (all the purchase order created by the user will be displayed in the list)
• New Raw material Purchase order.
• New Garment PO
• Search Garment PO
• List Garment PO
• Pending GMPO list (In case team is sourcing the main style directly from some supplier )they can create the GMPO againt the Style order.
chunks.locator: § Sourcing Module Overview

chunks.title: Supplier Management
chunks.heading: Supplier Management
chunks.text:
The Supplier area contains suppliers used for sourcing transactions across categories such as Textiles/Fabric, Apparel and Trims.
Typical workflow:
• Open Sourcing → Supplier.
• Search or select the required supplier.
• Review the supplier information and use the supplier during RMPO creation.
chunks.locator: § Supplier Management

chunks.title: Open New Raw Material Purchase Order
chunks.heading: Creating a Raw Material Purchase Order (RMPO) › Open New Raw Material Purchase Order
chunks.text: Go to Sourcing → My Purchase Order and select New Raw Material Purchase Order. The RMPO screen contains Header, Article Detail and Additional Charges sections.
chunks.locator: § Creating a Raw Material Purchase Order (RMPO) › Open New Raw Material Purchase Order

chunks.title: Complete Header Information
chunks.heading: Creating a Raw Material Purchase Order (RMPO) › Complete Header Information
chunks.text:
• Select the required Category (for example, Textiles/Fabric).
• Select the Supplier.
• Enter the required delivery and in-house dates.
• Select the applicable Currency.
• Complete all other mandatory header fields.
Figure 1. RMPO Article Detail screen showing quantity, UOM and price fields.
chunks.locator: § Creating a Raw Material Purchase Order (RMPO) › Complete Header Information

chunks.title: Article Details and UOM Validation
chunks.heading: Article Details and UOM Validation
chunks.text: After the header is completed, enter or review the article/material details. The Article Detail screen can include article, color, size, shipped quantity, open quantity, net open quantity, original UOM, ordered quantity, PO UOM, price and total value.
chunks.locator: § Article Details and UOM Validation

chunks.title: Quantity
chunks.heading: Article Details and UOM Validation › Quantity
chunks.text: Enter the quantity to be procured. Verify the quantity against the indent requirement before confirming the RMPO.
chunks.locator: § Article Details and UOM Validation › Quantity

chunks.title: UOM
chunks.heading: Article Details and UOM Validation › UOM
chunks.text:
The PO UOM can be changed where permitted. If the selected PO UOM differs from the indent UOM, the required UOM conversion must be defined in the system.
Important: If the required conversion is not defined, the system displays an alert such as “UOM conversion is not defined” and the transaction cannot proceed as expected.
chunks.locator: § Article Details and UOM Validation › UOM

chunks.title: Additional Charges
chunks.heading: Article Details and UOM Validation › Additional Charges
chunks.text: Use the Additional Charges section when applicable to the transaction and complete the fields required by your organization's commercial process.
chunks.locator: § Article Details and UOM Validation › Additional Charges

chunks.title: Indent Fulfillment Status
chunks.heading: Indent Fulfillment Status
chunks.text:
Indent Fulfillment Status is the primary monitoring screen for understanding how indent requirements are being fulfilled. It provides a consolidated view of order, receipt, stock adjustment, reservation and dispatch quantities.
Figure 2. Indent Fulfillment Status screen.
chunks.locator: § Indent Fulfillment Status

chunks.title: Search
chunks.heading: Indent Fulfillment Status › Search
chunks.text: Select the Buyer and, where available, Buyer Department and Season. Click Search to refresh the results.
chunks.locator: § Indent Fulfillment Status › Search

chunks.heading: Indent Fulfillment Status › Open Indent Details
chunks.text: Click the Indent Number to open the related indent details. The indent view provides visibility into the requirement and associated sourcing activity.
chunks.locator: § Indent Fulfillment Status › Open Indent Details

chunks.title: Create PO from an Indent
chunks.heading: Indent Fulfillment Status › Create PO from an Indent
chunks.text: Where enabled, select the required indent and use Create New PO to start an RMPO directly from the indent context.
chunks.locator: § Indent Fulfillment Status › Create PO from an Indent

chunks.title: Purchase Order Tracking
chunks.heading: Tracking PO and GRN › Purchase Order Tracking
chunks.text: When an order exists against an indent, the Order Quantity is shown in the fulfillment view. Selecting the order quantity opens the associated PO information, such as PO Number, PO Created On, Supplier Name, UOM and PO Quantity.
chunks.locator: § Tracking PO and GRN › Purchase Order Tracking

chunks.title: GRN Tracking
chunks.heading: Tracking PO and GRN › GRN Tracking
chunks.text: When material is received, GRN information is available against the PO. Selecting the relevant receipt quantity allows the user to review GRN Number, creation date, PO reference and received quantity.
chunks.locator: § Tracking PO and GRN › GRN Tracking

chunks.title: In-House Stock Adjustment
chunks.heading: In-House Stock Adjustment
chunks.text:
If suitable stock is already available in-house, the indent may be fulfilled through an In-House Adjustment, subject to user permissions and system configuration.
If stock is already available system will show indent number in green color as highlighted bellow.
chunks.locator: § In-House Stock Adjustment

chunks.title: Check Stock Availability
chunks.heading: In-House Stock Adjustment › Check Stock Availability
chunks.text:
Use Show Stock Availability from the indent list/indent context to identify available stock. The availability indicator helps users distinguish requirements for which stock can potentially be used.
Different adjustment option are available by which user can allocate the stock on indent.
chunks.locator: § In-House Stock Adjustment › Check Stock Availability

chunks.title: Make an In-House Adjustment
chunks.heading: In-House Stock Adjustment › Make an In-House Adjustment
chunks.text:
• Open/select the required indent.
• Confirm that relevant stock is available.
• Open In-House Adjustment.
• Click Search to retrieve matching stock.
• Review the source details, including GRN and site where displayed.
• Select the required stock and quantity.
• Complete the adjustment/reservation.
Figure 3. Indent List with Show Stock Availability and related actions.
chunks.locator: § In-House Stock Adjustment › Make an In-House Adjustment

chunks.title: In-House Equivalent Stock
chunks.heading: In-House Equivalent Stock
chunks.text:
When the exact stock is not available, an equivalent-stock option may be available where permitted. For example, the walkthrough demonstrates using equivalent stock when the exact material/color is not available.
• Open In-House Equivalent.
• Enter the required transaction details.
• Review available cartons/stock.
• Select the applicable stock and quantity.
• Complete the adjustment according to the configured process.
chunks.locator: § In-House Equivalent Stock

chunks.title: Filter
chunks.heading: Search, Filter, Sort and Export › Filter
chunks.text: Use the filter/search controls in the fulfillment or indent list to narrow results by criteria such as Article, Style, Material Type, Program, Division, PBSD Date, Buyer, Category and other available fields.
chunks.locator: § Search, Filter, Sort and Export › Filter

chunks.title: Column Selection and Order
chunks.heading: Search, Filter, Sort and Export › Column Selection and Order
chunks.text: Use the column customization controls to show or hide fields. Columns can be moved so that the most useful information appears first.
chunks.locator: § Search, Filter, Sort and Export › Column Selection and Order

chunks.title: Export
chunks.heading: Search, Filter, Sort and Export › Export
chunks.text:
After applying the required filters, use the grid Export option to download the displayed information. The walkthrough demonstrates export to CSV/Excel for further analysis.
Figure 4. Indent List with filtering, column controls and export actions.
chunks.locator: § Search, Filter, Sort and Export › Export

chunks.title: Reporting & Analysis
chunks.heading: Reporting & Analysis
chunks.text:
The Sourcing Module provides reporting and analysis options for sourcing transactions. The walkthrough specifically demonstrates:
• Indent Report – review indents created in the system.
• Purchase Order / System Order Report – review purchase orders created in the system.
chunks.locator: § Reporting & Analysis

chunks.title: End-to-End Sourcing Process
chunks.heading: End-to-End Sourcing Process
chunks.text:
• Review indent requirement.
• Check existing stock availability.
• If suitable stock is available, perform the applicable in-house adjustment.
• If stock is not available, create an RMPO.
• Select category, supplier, dates, currency and other mandatory details.
• Enter quantity and verify UOM/conversion.
• Create/confirm the purchase order.
• Track PO and GRN receipt quantities.
• Monitor in-house adjustments, unreserved quantities and dispatch.
• Use reports/export for operational analysis.
chunks.locator: § End-to-End Sourcing Process

chunks.title: Quick Reference – Daily Sourcing Checklist
chunks.heading: Quick Reference – Daily Sourcing Checklist
chunks.text:
• Review assigned/open indents.
• Check required quantity, UOM and material attributes.
• Check stock availability.
• Use in-house adjustment when applicable.
• Otherwise create/complete RMPO.
• Verify supplier, dates, currency and quantity.
• Confirm UOM conversion where required.
• Track PO and GRN quantities.
• Monitor dispatch and pending-to-dispatch quantities.
• Export filtered data or use reports when required.
chunks.locator: § Quick Reference – Daily Sourcing Checklist
